inspection.reviewer: Codex root; actual retained image inspection
inspection.findings: At 1 second title content, repeater count and mask feather revise through ordinary native edits. The overlay remains attached to the moving target. The stabilized target holds position at the inspected start/end frames with exposed borders. Text stays legible within its bounds.
inspection.scope: Synthetic technical integration; no real-footage tracking accuracy or Adobe output-equivalence claim
inspection.external_qa: Installed FFmpeg skill extracted comparison/still frames and overlaid timecodes; native pictures are rendered by Ferrocut

verification.scope: Selected four packages; not whole workspace; focused test totals overlap

adapters: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU / Vulkan
hardware_focus.scope: 18 masks and the earlier 17 vector-group tests. Mask GPU pixels and vector uploads exercised both adapters; vector-group timeline checks used llvmpipe. Two later independent CPU geometry tests are covered by the final regression. No bitwise cross-adapter parity claim.

limitations: Previously recorded color-crate parallel GPU test crash and Chromium sandbox issue remain outside this scope.

Tracking is forward seeded point analysis; attach accepts exact constant positive/reverse clip speeds. No planar solve, two-point rotation/scale, tracked mask geometry, crop/fill, nonlinear retime inversion or real-footage drift validation.
Mask feather is isotropic; effect-specific masks and isolated vector-group opacity remain absent.
